question: Should OpenClaw accept read-scoped runtime-config drift path names and an awaited disk snapshot read on cached health responses for this gateway health diagnostic?
rationale: The code path is additive and tested, but the auth-adjacent visibility boundary and health-RPC latency tradeoff are operational product choices that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
options.body: Land after exact-head CI because the diff is additive, redacts sensitive details, and the supplied terminal proof shows the read-scoped health path behavior.

options.title: Coarsen Or Defer Read-Scope Detail
options.body: Require a smaller read-scoped message or admin-only drift paths if maintainers consider auth/provider path names too sensitive for `operator.read`.

options.title: Pause For Companion Policy Review
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want diagnostics and the hot-mode restart behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89517 reviewed as one policy bundle.

recommendation.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head CI because the diff is additive, redacts sensitive details, and the supplied terminal proof shows the read-scoped health path behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the recent health cache and payload refactor that this PR extends.
